title: MiaoMiao Libre Bluetooth disconnected
symptom: The user left their phone on a desk and walked away, causing several 5-minute intervals to be missed and the Bluetooth to disconnect. Upon returning, xDrip+ reported being disconnected for 52 minutes and failed to reawaken. Force closing and restarting the app brought it back to life.
fix: One user reported that forgetting the device and reconnecting it helps. Another user mentioned that following the settings from ahaverty in issue #628 resolved the disconnecting and reconnecting issue.
evidence_quote: i have had this issue awhile and find forgetting device and reconnecting it helps
